Container.Name: SupabaseKong
Container.Overview: Kong is the API gateway used by the official self-hosted Supabase Docker stack. It routes Studio, Auth, REST, GraphQL, Realtime, Storage, and Edge Functions through a single public endpoint.
Container.Requires: This template runs only the Kong gateway container from the official Supabase Docker Compose stack. It requires the Supabase kong.yml and kong-entrypoint.sh files from supabase/docker/volumes/api mounted below. It does not install Studio, Auth, PostgREST, Realtime, Storage, Edge Runtime, Postgres Meta, or Postgres. Put all Supabase containers on the same custom Docker network and make sure the service hostnames used inside kong.yml, such as studio, auth, rest, realtime, storage, functions, and meta, resolve to the matching containers. Generate new Supabase keys before first use; never keep the example keys.

Config.Name: HTTP Gateway Port
Config.Description: Supabase HTTP API gateway port. Container port: 8000.

Config.Name: HTTPS Gateway Port
Config.Description: Supabase HTTPS API gateway port. Container port: 8443. Mount TLS files and set Kong SSL variables if you enable direct TLS here.

Config.Name: Kong Config
Config.Description: Official Supabase Kong declarative config copied from supabase/docker/volumes/api/kong.yml.

Config.Name: Kong Entrypoint
Config.Description: Official Supabase Kong entrypoint copied from supabase/docker/volumes/api/kong-entrypoint.sh.

Config.Name: TLS Certificate
Config.Description: Optional TLS certificate for direct HTTPS on Kong. Usually a reverse proxy terminates TLS instead.

Config.Name: TLS Private Key
Config.Description: Optional TLS private key for direct HTTPS on Kong. Usually a reverse proxy terminates TLS instead.

Config.Name: Database Mode
Config.Description: Kong database mode. Supabase uses declarative DB-less config.

Config.Name: Declarative Config Path
Config.Description: Generated Kong config path inside the container.

Config.Name: DNS Order
Config.Description: Kong DNS resolution order used by the Supabase stack.

Config.Name: DNS Not Found TTL
Config.Description: Kong DNS negative cache TTL in seconds.

Config.Name: Plugins
Config.Description: Kong plugins required by the Supabase gateway config.

Config.Name: Proxy Buffer Size
Config.Description: Kong Nginx proxy buffer size used by the Supabase stack.

Config.Name: Proxy Buffers
Config.Description: Kong Nginx proxy buffers used by the Supabase stack.

Config.Name: Proxy Access Log
Config.Description: Kong proxy access log target.

Config.Name: SSL Certificate Path
Config.Description: Optional TLS certificate path inside the container, for example /home/kong/server.crt.

Config.Name: SSL Key Path
Config.Description: Optional TLS private key path inside the container, for example /home/kong/server.key.

Config.Name: Anon Key
Config.Description: Legacy anon API key generated for the Supabase stack.

Config.Name: Service Role Key
Config.Description: Legacy service role API key. Never expose this key to client-side code.

Config.Name: Publishable Key
Config.Description: Optional opaque publishable API key for newer self-hosted Supabase setups.

Config.Name: Secret Key
Config.Description: Optional opaque secret API key for newer self-hosted Supabase setups. Never expose this key to client-side code.

Config.Name: Anon Asymmetric Key
Config.Description: Optional pre-signed asymmetric JWT API key for the anon role.

Config.Name: Service Role Asymmetric Key
Config.Description: Optional pre-signed asymmetric JWT API key for the service_role role.

Config.Name: Dashboard Username
Config.Description: Basic auth username for Supabase Studio through Kong.

Config.Name: Dashboard Password
Config.Description: Basic auth password for Supabase Studio through Kong. Set a secure password before first start.
